flows.title: Reply to a review
steps: Click on All and it will display the received reviews.
Click on Haven't replied, which will show only the reviews that you haven't replied to.
Select a Template, and the template content will auto-populate in the response box.
Click on the Post reply button on the bottom right.
There are multiple templates available by default within the dashboard. Additional response templates will appear in the drop-down once you add new templates under Settings.
